metadata.division: DIVISION 8-3-1. PURPOSE AND APPLICATION OF ARTICLE

content.title: 8-3-1-2. Application of article.
content.summary: This Article is organized into Divisions that are set out in an order that roughly corresponds to the table subheadings in Table 8-2-2-2, Decision-Making Tracks by Application Type.

faqs.a: This Article is organized into Divisions that are set out in an order that roughly corresponds to the table subheadings in Table 8-2-2-2, Decision-Making Tracks by Application Type. The Divisions include purpose standards and specific application requirements, approval criteria, procedural modifications, and/or other special considerations for various application types.
